feature: The mutating line - 20 examples (relaid out per 2026-09-03 layout audit)

shapes.text:
1 - the base case: a hook, an
effect port, one tether.
2 - same shape, a dict this time.

3 - a set. adding still mutates
with no return.

4 - extend copies elements in; the
argument still just mutates.

5 - in-place reordering: no new
list, no return, just the hook.

6 - same idea, cheaper: reverses
the list in place.

7 - two ordinary args plus the one
that mutates.

8 - the extreme case: every
element leaves, none return.

props.name: MEDIUM — returns a value AND mutates (9–12)

systemSketch.sourcePageName: MEDIUM — returns a value AND mutates (9–12)

shapes.text:
9 - a real output AND an effect
port, wired to two different
consumers.

10 - same split as pop() above,
keyed by name instead of position.

11 - three inputs, a real return,
and an effect port: the busiest
header here.

12 - a deque's own pop: value and
effect, front instead of back.

props.name: MEDIUM/HARD — multiple mutated arguments, and the receiver (13–16)

shapes.text:
13 - a's port sits right, b's sits
left, reversed from argument
order, so the cables cross on
purpose.

14 - three mutated arguments,
three effect ports on one top
edge.

15 - self mutates like any other
argument; the receiver isn't
special.

16 - same receiver pattern, a
different shape of state.

effect port both hide
until hover, like every subtle

hook (orange, opens left) = this
call rewrites its
argument in place. Port on the top

solid orange cable, 'mut' pill:
this value exists only because of

The mutating line - 20 examples, easy to hard

callouts.text:
Start here. 20 real mutating calls, laid out easy to hard.
Each tier below is its own labeled frame; every example is
numbered 1-20 in orange. See the Legend frame (bottom) for
what every hook, port, and cable style means.

PASS WHEN
Every mutated argument shows a hook.
Every effect port sits on the top edge.
Tethers are right-angled, and may cross when ports do.
Nesting shows independently at each level.
The combined pill reads mut z⁻¹ = 1.0.
Simple view reveals the hook and the port on hover.
